name: Stromgarde Keep
shortDescription: Stromgarde Keep, a Classic-era setting in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: This location appears in the Classic quest sequence. Original Classic-era Arathi Highlands ruin language: weathered grey human masonry, broken keeps and arches, abandoned courtyards, dry grass and rocky hills. The Keepsake of Remembrance has a variable search location and is not pinned to one building. The scene is interpretive; the story-tour marker and theater staging assert no exact geographic coordinates.
